item.text: [{"task_id":"332202d5","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    axis = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    separator = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    coordinate = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    points = np.argwhere(grid == axis)","    if len(points) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    column = int(points[0, coordinate])","    height, width = grid.shape","    seeds = []","    colors = []","    for row in range(height):","        values = [int(value) for value in np.unique(grid[row]) if int(value) != background and int(value) != axis and int(value) != separator]","        if len(values) > 0:","            seeds.append(row)","            colors.append(values[0])","    if len(seeds) == 0:","        return grid.copy()","    result = np.full(grid.shape, separator, dtype=int)","    for row in range(height):","        distances = [abs(row - seed) for seed in seeds]","        nearest = min(distances)","        candidates = [colors[index] for index in range(len(seeds)) if distances[index] == nearest]","        if len(set(candidates)) == 1:","            result[row, :] = candidates[0]","        result[row, column] = separator","        if row in seeds:","            result[row, :] = separator","            result[row, column] = axis","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"geometry":[1]},"params":{"colors":[7,8,1],"geometry":[1]},"rationale":"Expand each horizontal color into its nearest-row region. Equidistant rows between different colors become blue separators; ties between identical colors retain that color.
